q1.question: What can J.A.R.V.I.S. actually do for me?
q1.answer: It's a multi-agent AI assistant: semantic RAG document search, automatic AI model routing, and 30+ tool skills (reading files, running code, calling APIs...) — all through one natural conversation.

q2.question: Which AI models does it use, and how are they chosen?
q2.answer: The agent automatically routes between DeepSeek, Gemini, and Claude based on request complexity and cost — you never have to pick a model yourself.

q3.question: Is my uploaded data safe?
q3.answer: Yes. RAG data and documents are isolated per account (multi-tenant) and never shared across other users.

q4.question: What languages are supported?
q4.answer: Vietnamese and English — both the interface and the agent's replies follow whichever language you've selected.

q5.question: How do I get started?
q5.answer: Just sign up — no installation required. You can start chatting with the agent right after verifying your email.
